summary: Momeik Airport serves the town of Momeik (also known as Mong Mit) in northern Shan State, Myanmar. It operates as a small regional airstrip situated in the country's rugged eastern highlands, primarily supporting general aviation and limited domestic connectivity. The facility provides an important link for remote communities in an area characterized by mountainous terrain and limited road infrastructure.
